diagnosis: This episode demonstrates a systematic workflow for designing HCI formative studies, combining academic methodology research (CHI paper standards) with domain-specific knowledge (coding agent developer pain points) to produce a complete research plan. No existing skill covers HCI research methodology for developer tools.
semantic_delta: Adding capability for designing and conducting HCI formative studies, specifically for developer tools and AI coding agents. Includes research question formulation, participant recruitment strategies, semi-structured interview protocol design, and CHI paper contribution alignment.

candidate_skill.name: hci-formative-study-design
candidate_skill.description: Design and conduct HCI formative studies for developer tools and coding agents. Supports research question formulation, participant recruitment, interview protocol design, and CHI paper contribution structuring.
candidate_skill.activation: When user needs to design a user study for HCI research, conduct developer interviews, create formative study methodology, or write CHI paper methodology sections.
procedure: Clarify research goals and target user population (e.g., developers using coding agents)
Review CHI methodology contribution requirements (Context → Content → Contribution framework)
Identify relevant existing research and pain points in the domain
Define specific research questions (RQ1, RQ2, RQ3 format)
Design participant recruitment strategy with clear inclusion/exclusion criteria
Segment participants into meaningful groups (e.g., non-users, churners, adopters)
Create screening questionnaire to identify suitable participants
Design semi-structured interview protocol using 5E framework (Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate)
Balance open-ended questions (for exploration) with closed questions (for validation)
Structure interview flow: background (5min) → theme exploration (40min) → deep probing (10min) → summary (5min)
Align methodology section with CHI contribution requirements for replicability and value demonstration
candidate_skill.termination: When user has a complete formative study design including research questions, participant plan, and interview protocol ready for IRB/ethics review and execution.
